platform.guestExecutionPolicyOverride: process-only Bypass for the selected build script

method: A private, SHA-256-checked bundle transferred the exact alpha.5 package pair and selected inputs to the native Windows ARM64 guest.
The guest installed both tarballs with a private empty npm cache, offline mode, scripts disabled, and an unreachable registry.
The installed public CLI built the selected request with empty PATH; six Candidate member digests were compared with the selected macOS Candidate.

The guest result was read back by a bounded loopback upload. A separate read-only guest postflight found no owned scratch, Node process, or process-level execution-policy override; the host then restored and checked VM isolation.
limits: This is a local native Windows ARM64 replay, not off-host disaster recovery or a protected release.
Package and Candidate digests are provisional alpha.5 identities; source-owner adoption and human visual acceptance are separate.
Raw transport and postflight logs remain in ignored local test work; this signed record attributes the observation but does not independently authenticate the guest.
The process-only PowerShell execution-policy override is confined to the selected test invocation; it does not establish a general policy for user scripts.
